verdicts.reason: A: the three title bars are scaled up to fill the width, but the pale translucent band behind them stops partway through the TRAVEL and KIT bars, which looks like an accident. The word inside each bar also drifts off-centre (MAKEUP sits right, KIT sits left), and the cosmetics that framed the original on the left and right are cropped away. B: the bars sit centred inside the band, so it reads as a deliberate panel, but the title is undersized for the canvas, leaving large dead areas above and below. It has the same off-centre text inside the bars and the same loss of the framing products.
